source_title: Opposition Moves Symbolic CEC Impeachment, BJP Slams Protest Ahead of Rally - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
The INDIA bloc has organised symbolic impeachment proceedings against the Chief Election Commissioner at Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge's residence, with former Speaker Meira Kumar presiding. Mallikarjun Kharge moved the motion, and Rahul Gandhi is scheduled to deliver the final remarks. Opposition leaders have accused the central government and the Chief Election Commissioner of weakening democracy ahead of their planned rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1. Rahul Gandhi alleged that the Home Minister is attempting to stop crowds and transport from reaching Delhi for the event. In response, Home Minister Amit Shah challenged the opposition to a debate on the Election Commission during a special Parliament session, asserting they are merely blaming the umpire after poll losses. The Bharatiya Janata Party strongly defended the Election Commission, calling it a globally acclaimed constitutional body. Meanwhile, legal arguments over the right to peaceful protest and reasonable curbs under Article 19 continue to surround the planned demonstration. Read More

Delhi Shoe Factory Blaze: 4 Dead, 2 Injured in Mangolpuri as Rescue Teams Fight Fire
At least four persons were killed and two others injured after a massive fire broke out in the basement of a shoe factory in Delhi's Mangolpuri Industrial Area around 9:30 p.m. on 30 October. Six individuals rescued unconscious from inside the building were rushed to the hospital, where four were declared dead while two remain under medical treatment. Over 20 fire tenders were dispatched to combat the blaze, taking roughly four hours to bring the fire under control amid presence of highly inflammable rubber and chemical materials. Police and forensic teams have launched an investigation into the incident, examining building layout compliance, entry and exit provisions, and fire safety norms.
PM Hails ISRO Launch, NVS-03 Satellite Orbit Boost and Five New Missions
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite aboard the GSLV-F18 rocket, strengthening India's indigenous NavIC constellation. The satellite was injected into an orbit of 170.3 kilometres by 38,080 kilometres. The mission deployed India's third indigenous atomic clock into orbit, serving as a critical timing component for regional positioning and civilian as well as strategic navigation services. Prime Minister Narendra Modi commended ISRO scientists and engineers, describing the launch as an important milestone in advancing technological self-reliance. Officials confirmed the satellite systems and solar panels are functioning normally. ISRO also announced plans to carry out five additional launches within the current financial year while progressing towards the first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission.
Ekta Diwas: Delhi Flags Off Run For Unity; PM Narendra Modi To Lead Ekta Parv In Kevadia
India marks Rashtriya Ekta Diwas to honour the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. In New Delhi, dignitaries, including the President of India, Union Home Minister, and Delhi Chief Minister, paid floral tributes at Patel Chowk and flagged off the Run for Unity from the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium. The marathon saw extensive participation from youth, students, and volunteers heading towards India Gate. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi is in Ekta Nagar, Kevadia, Gujarat, to offer floral tributes at the Statue of Unity, inaugurate developmental projects worth around 400 crore rupees, and lead the Ekta Parv parade in the evening. This year's parade highlights national integration alongside key themes such as a Naxal-free India, 150 years of Vande Mataram, and anti-drug campaigns, featuring displays by paramilitary daredevils, state police, and regional cultural troupes.
Ekta Diwas 2026: Run For Unity Held Across India; PM Narendra Modi To Lead Kevadia Parade
Across India, celebrations for National Unity Day or Rashtriya Ekta Diwas are underway to commemorate the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. In New Delhi, the Run for Unity commenced from Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, flagged off by Union Home Minister Amit Shah alongside local dignitaries. Events featuring students, NCC, and NSS volunteers were organised nationwide to bolster integration. In Kevadia, Gujarat, Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid floral tributes at the 182-metre Statue of Unity and inaugurated development projects worth approximately 400 crore rupees for Ekta Nagar. The evening schedule includes an Ekta Parade showcasing paramilitary forces, Cobra Commandos, state police contingents, cultural tableaus, and bike rallies. A key theme of the parade highlights a Naxal-free India, featuring 2,000 youths from formerly affected districts in special performances alongside commemorative tributes marking 150 years of Vande Mataram.
